description: Twenty shows "Latest" when it cannot fetch the latest version ## Bug Description When I check for the latest version on the admin panel, I get "latest" as the latest version. That is not very helpful to decide, if an update is available. ## Expected behavior The current latest version is v2.20.0, so that should be shown ## Technical inputs This is probably from docker hub, where latest = v2 = v2.20 = v2.20.0 and the top one is "latest", but non numeric versions should not be displayed
